Heron Dental of Carrollwood is an independently owned family dental practice on N Dale Mabry Hwy in Carrollwood, Tampa. Dr. Alisha Anand and her team look after the whole family, from a child's first checkup to implants for grandparents: cleanings, fillings, crowns, Invisalign and same-day emergency care, with implants planned using 3D CBCT imaging.

01Meet your dentist

Dr. Alisha Anand, Tampa Bay born and raised.

Dr. Anand trained at Tufts University School of Dental Medicine and Westchester Medical Center, and brings a background in psychology to every appointment. She now owns the Carrollwood practice: same office and same team, now Heron Dental.

Her approach: explain what's going on, lay out the options, and help you decide on your own terms.

03How we're different

Comprehensive care that never feels pushy.

You'll always know what we found, what your options are and what they cost. Then the choice is yours.

  1. 01

    We listen first

    Every visit starts with what you've noticed and what you want, before anyone picks up an instrument.

  2. 02

    We show you what we see

    Your scans and photos go up on the screen so you can see exactly what's going on in your mouth.

  3. 03

    You decide

    You'll get clear options and honest recommendations. No pressure, and no treatment you didn't agree to.

  4. 04

    A calm, unhurried visit

    Time for questions, comfort options when you want them, and a team that keeps things relaxed.

  5. 05

    Costs before treatment

    We check your benefits and walk you through the cost up front, so there are no surprises later.

04Technology, explained

Implants planned around the tooth you'll end up with.

We plan every implant from the final tooth backwards, so it looks and works right, not just wherever an implant happens to fit.

How dental implants work →

01

3D CBCT imaging

A 3D view of your jaw, nerves and sinuses. Dr. Anand uses it to plan each implant around the final tooth, so it looks and works right.

02

Intraoral scans

A quick digital scan instead of messy impression trays. Comparing scans year over year shows how your bite is changing.

10Questions

Straight answers.

Are you accepting new patients?

Yes. Kids, adults and seniors are welcome. Book online or call (813) 265-2273, and we'll find a time that works.

Do you take my insurance?

We're in network with most PPO dental plans and file the claim for you. Call us with your plan and we'll check your benefits before your visit.

Can I be seen the same day for a dental emergency?

Whenever we can. A broken tooth, a toothache or a lost crown: if it feels like an emergency to you, we treat it like one. Call first thing and we'll fit you in.

Is Tampa Dental Wellness of Carrollwood still here?

Yes, same office and same team. The practice is now Heron Dental of Carrollwood, led by Dr. Alisha Anand.

It starts with a conversation.

Tell us what's going on and what you'd like. We'll take it from there, at your pace.
